question: Should the deterministic Testbox concurrency tests be accepted as sufficient proof, or must this PR add a live Telegram or WhatsApp reconnect/suspension trace before merge?
rationale: The implementation is focused, matches the established admission contract, and has strong regression coverage, but the external-PR real-behavior proof gate remains unsatisfied.

options.title: Require live trace
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted logs or terminal output demonstrate provider-in-flight blocking, prepared-state fencing, and safe completion after resume.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: Explicitly accept the deterministic Testbox coverage as sufficient for this internal concurrency path.

recommendation.title: Require live trace
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted logs or terminal output demonstrate provider-in-flight blocking, prepared-state fencing, and safe completion after resume.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history connects this person to cooperative suspension and the shared runtime surfaces, making them the strongest available owner for the proof threshold decision.
